description: Interface defining methods for user management within the OpenMRS system, including user creation, update, deletion, role and privilege management, password handling, and user properties.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Interface for user-related operations, extending OpenmrsService, including methods for user CRUD, password management, role and privilege handling, and user properties.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user with a specified password, returning the created User object.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Updates the password of a specified user, considering old password verification and security constraints.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves a user by internal ID.

methods.name: getUserByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a user based on their UUID.

methods.name: getUserByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their username/login ID.

methods.name: getUserByUsernameOrEmail
methods.description: Fetches a user by username or email.

methods.name: getUserByActivationKey
methods.description: Finds a user using their account activation key.

methods.name: hasDuplicateUsername
methods.description: Checks whether a username or system ID already exists.

methods.name: getUsersByRole
methods.description: Retrieves users assigned to a specific role.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Updates or persists a user object in the database.

methods.name: retireUser
methods.description: Deactivates a user account, marking it as retired.

methods.name: unretireUser
methods.description: Reactivates a retired user account.

methods.name: purgeUser
methods.description: Permanently deletes a user from the database.

methods.name: purgeUser
methods.description: Deletes a user from the database, with optional cascading.

methods.name: getAllPrivileges
methods.description: Returns a list of all privileges in the system.

methods.name: getAllRoles
methods.description: Returns a list of all roles in the system.

methods.name: saveRole
methods.description: Saves or updates a role in the system.

methods.name: purgeRole
methods.description: Permanently deletes a role.

methods.name: savePrivilege
methods.description: Saves or updates a privilege.

methods.name: purgePrivilege
methods.description: Deletes a privilege from the system.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Retrieves a role based on its name.

methods.name: getRoleByUuid
methods.description: Finds a role using its UUID.

methods.name: getPrivilege
methods.description: Fetches a privilege object by its name.

methods.name: getPrivilegeByUuid
methods.description: Finds a privilege by UUID.

methods.name: getAllUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all users in the system.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Changes the current user's password.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Changes the password for a specific user, assuming sufficient privileges.

methods.name: changeHashedPassword
methods.description: Sets a user's password directly using a hashed value and salt.

methods.name: changeQuestionAnswer
methods.description: Updates a user's secret question and answer.

methods.name: changeQuestionAnswer
methods.description: Updates the current user's secret question and answer.

methods.name: getSecretQuestion
methods.description: Retrieves the secret question for a user.

methods.name: isSecretAnswer
methods.description: Verifies whether a provided answer matches the user's secret answer.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Searches for users matching name criteria and roles, with options for inclusion of voided users.

methods.name: getUsersByName
methods.description: Finds users matching exact first and last names.

methods.name: getUsersByPerson
methods.description: Gets all user accounts linked to a specific person object.

methods.name: setUserProperty
methods.description: Adds or updates a key-value property on a user.

methods.name: removeUserProperty
methods.description: Removes a key-value property from a user.

methods.name: generateSystemId
methods.description: Generates a new system ID for a user.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users matching certain criteria.

methods.name: getCountOfUsers
methods.description: Counts users matching name, role, and retirement status filters.

methods.name: saveUserProperty
methods.description: Stores a key/value pair as a property for the current user.

methods.name: saveUserProperties
methods.description: Replaces all properties for the current user with a provided map.

methods.name: changePasswordUsingSecretAnswer
methods.description: Updates account password if the secret answer is verified.

methods.name: setUserActivationKey
methods.description: Assigns an activation key to a user for password reset.

methods.name: changePasswordUsingActivationKey
methods.description: Resets a user's password using an activation key.

methods.name: getDefaultLocaleForUser
methods.description: Retrieves user's preferred locale.

methods.name: getLastLoginTime
methods.description: Gets the timestamp of the user's last login.
